model_annotation: The plot illustrates the proportion of veterans within the total population over time. The x-axis is labeled "Year" and has a linear scale ranging from 1960 to 2010, with tick labels placed every 10 years. The y-axis is labeled with percentage values, ranging from 0 to 15% with a linear scale and tick labels placed every 5%. A single red line with circular markers represents the data. At the start of the x-axis in 1960, the line begins at 12.8%. In 1970 it is at 13.8%. In 1980, the line shows a value of 12.1%. By 1990 the line is at 11.0%, followed by 9.4% in 2000, and finally, 7% in 2010.
